summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 9: Operating Hours & Availability Display features. All 18 backend tests pass (100%). All frontend features working correctly: Navbar shows store status indicator (red pulsing dot + 'Closed' + 'Opens today at 10 AM'), Closed Overlay shows on homepage with clock icon, 'WE'RE CLOSED' badge, 'We'll Be Back Soon' heading, next opening time, today's hours card, 'Browse Menu' and 'Order for Later' buttons. Closed Overlay correctly does NOT show on /menu, /product/*, /login, /signup, /admin/* pages. Admin Hours page shows 'Ordering is Active' card with 'Pause Ordering' button, service type tabs (Delivery/Pickup/Dine-In), day-by-day table with open/close time inputs and toggle switches. Sunday shows 11:00 AM opening (seeded differently from weekdays 10:00 AM). Admin Holidays page shows Add Closure Date form with date picker and reason, Upcoming Closures list. Holiday CRUD (create/delete) working. Pause Ordering toggle working.
critical_code_review_comments: StoreStatusContext.js: Correctly fetches /api/store/status and polls every 60 seconds
Navbar.js: Store status indicator shows green/red dot with open/close time
AdminHours.js: Day-by-day config with service tabs (Delivery/Pickup/Dine-In), pause ordering toggle
AdminHolidays.js: Holiday CRUD with date picker and reason input
AdminLayout.js: Hours link correctly positioned between Modifiers and Orders in sidebar
server.py: Store hours seeded with Sunday 11:00 AM opening (different from weekdays 10:00 AM)
server.py: Store status endpoint uses UTC time for open/closed calculation
seed_data_creation: Default store hours seeded: Mon-Sat 10AM-10PM, Sun 11AM-10PM for all service types (delivery, pickup, dine_in)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 9 operating hours features fully tested. Key features: (1) Store is currently showing as 'Closed' because server time (UTC) is before 10:00 AM, (2) Closed overlay only shows on homepage (/), not on /menu, /product, /login, /admin etc, (3) Navbar shows red pulsing dot + 'Closed' + 'Opens today at 10 AM', (4) Admin Hours page at /admin/hours has pause ordering toggle, service tabs, day-by-day table, (5) Sunday opens at 11:00 AM (different from weekdays 10:00 AM), (6) Admin Holidays page at /admin/holidays has add/delete holiday functionality, (7) All backend APIs working: GET /api/store/status, GET/PUT /api/admin/store/hours, POST /api/admin/store/pause, GET/POST/DELETE /api/admin/store/holidays. Apple and Facebook social login buttons remain MOCKED.
